title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space and defense sectors are buzzing with activity, from new funding initiatives to strategic partnerships aimed at enhancing national security. As companies vie for a slice of the expanding market, the focus on resilience and innovation remains paramount.

themes.title: Funding for Space Resilience
themes.body: The recent FY27 budget markup adds $1.4 billion to the space resilience line, signaling a serious commitment to strengthening capabilities. This influx of cash could spur innovation and competition among contractors.

themes.title: Strategic Partnerships Emerge
themes.body: Anduril and L3Harris are teaming up for a tactical SDA constellation bid, highlighting the trend of collaboration in a competitive landscape. Such alliances may be crucial for navigating the complexities of modern defense needs.

themes.title: Expansion in Production Capabilities
themes.body: Relativity Space's decision to expand Terran R production in Florida underscores the growing demand for launch services. This move could position the company favorably as competition heats up in the commercial launch market.

themes.title: Geopolitical Tensions Influence Strategy
themes.body: The ongoing strategic competition with China is prompting a reevaluation of multi-domain capabilities, as seen in various industry discussions. This geopolitical backdrop is likely to shape investments and innovations in the space sector for years to come.
